topic: Changes materials undergo when exposed to temperature
key_concepts: Matter occupies space and has mass
Matter has three states: solid, liquid, and gas
Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness of an object
Thermometers measure temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit
Changes in temperature can change the state of matter
Physical change does not form a new substance
Physical changes include changes in shape, size, or phase
Melting is the change from solid to liquid
Solidification or freezing is the change from liquid to solid
Vaporization is the change from liquid to gas
Condensation is the change from gas to liquid
Chemical change forms a new substance and is irreversible
